National Ranking: Largest CU in Manitoba; 7th largest in Canada (excl. Quebec/Desjardins); [E-007]

Trend Classification: ACCELERATING — M&A-driven transformation 2022-2023 followed by organic growth acceleration 2024-2025. Net income growth of 58% in FY2025 signals operational leverage from integration completion.

firmographics.narrative_md:
Wiebe's strategic vision in her own words: "Our vision has always been to be the best we can be for our members. What may change is how we get there — adapting processes, embracing collaboration, and finding new ways to support our members and staff." [Penticton Herald, Aug 2025]. On branch strategy: "These changes are driven by lower in-branch traffic and the growing adoption of online and mobile banking." [Steinbach Online, Feb 2026].

Legal Name: Access Credit Union Limited

Established: 2009 (as Access CU; credit union heritage since 1939 via Altona CU)

Headquarters (Legal): Stanley Business Centre, Unit 2 23111 PTH 14, Stanley, MB R6P 0B1

Primary Markets:

• Winnipeg Metropolitan Area

• Southern Manitoba

• Rural Manitoba

• National (via Hubert Financial GIC platform)

Ownership Structure: Member-owned cooperative. 208,000+ member-owners as at FY2025.

Board Structure: 12-member Board of Directors (2025). Chair: Curt Letkeman. Vice Chair: Robert Riddell. 5 standing committees: Audit, Risk, Governance, People & Culture, CEO Performance. [E-010, E-044]

The consolidated entity includes 8 wholly-owned subsidiaries arising from the 2022-2023 merger program. Sub-brands in operation: Hubert Financial (happysavings.ca) — national online GIC savings platform serving Canadians nationwide; Accelerate Financial — Manitoba-focused digital banking sub-brand.
